text.p: CIDCO Inc said the strong direct marketing programs undertaken with the telephone operating companies in the first quarter may not be sustainable through 1997.

Strong demand from these programs contributed to first quarter sales' performance as adjunct Caller-ID units accounted for 96 percent of total sales. These programs incur higher sales and marketing expenses, which rose to $20.4 million in the quarter, but declined as a percentage of sales from the fourth quarter.
CIDCO is forming strategies to make its revenues more predictable by 1998 and to develop businesses beyond adjunct products.
